title: Trump-backed candidate wins high-stakes GOP primary for New Hampshire battleground district
summary: Donald Trump endorsed Anthony DiLorenzo defeated Novel Iron Works owner Hollie Noveletsky and state Rep. Brian Cole to clinch the GOP nomination for the Granite State's 1st Congressional District.

title: Incumbent GOP governor rolls to primary victory after keeping Trump at a distance
summary: Kelly Ayotte cruised past Republican primary challengers, setting up a high-stakes New Hampshire governor's race against Democrat Cinde Warmington.

title: Can the 'best showman in politics' deliver again? GOP bets on Trump at historic midterm convention
summary: Donald Trump headlines the first-ever GOP midterm convention in Dallas, aiming to energize low-propensity MAGA voters ahead of key 2026 races.

title: Trump's unusual role at midterm convention revealed as schedule goes public
summary: Trump headlines both nights of the RNC's first-ever GOP midterm convention in Dallas, with JD Vance delivering the Thursday keynote speech.

title: Trump posthumously awards Medal of Freedom to 9/11's 'man in red bandana'
summary: President Donald Trump awards the Presidential Medal of Freedom posthumously to Welles Crowther, the heroic "man in the red bandana" who saved up to 18 lives during the September 11 attacks.

title: Appeals court upholds order blocking IRS from sharing taxpayer data with ICE
summary: A federal appeals court upheld an injunction blocking the IRS from sharing taxpayer information with ICE, ruling the policy violated tax confidentiality laws.

title: Senator's daughter wins Democratic nod in closely watched race to replace outgoing Dem incumbent
summary: Stefany Shaheen defeated Maura Sullivan and a crowded Democratic field in the NH primary to replace Chris Pappas, who is pursuing a Senate bid.

title: State of play: Retiring Dem senator’s daughter holds slight lead in closely watched race
summary: Stefany Shaheen and Maura Sullivan remain locked in a too-close-to-call New Hampshire primary as Chris Pappas vacates the seat for a Senate bid.

title: Data shows Amazon jet’s key braking systems did not deploy during deadly Miami crash: NTSB
summary: The NTSB said the cargo jet’s wheel brakes were applied, but its speed brakes and thrust reversers did not deploy, according to available data.

title: LSU leaves former pro-athletes off final roster, one night before SEC takes Lane Kiffin and Tigers to court
summary: The LSU Tigers finalized their 105-player roster without former Ole Miss players Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris amid the ongoing SEC lawsuit.
